lines.speaker: lyla
lines.text: The lookbook client paid. After two reminders and a very polite legal-sounding email.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Does that mean the Umbreon fund is safe?

lines.speaker: lyla
lines.text: Rent first. Umbreon second. But yes. I wanted someone to tell.

choices.label: Celebrate with a card shop visit
choices.reply: That is, surprisingly, exactly what I wanted to hear.

choices.label: Tell her she earned every cent
choices.reply: I did. It feels good to hear that said plainly.

lines.speaker: lyla
lines.text: Remember the sportswear advertisement? They accepted the new wording.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: So no more miracle abs in ten days?

lines.speaker: lyla
lines.text: Just comfortable clothes and actual movement. Almost revolutionary.

choices.label: Congratulate her on standing firm
choices.reply: Thanks. It was a small fight. Still worth winning.

choices.label: Ask her to show you the finished ad
choices.reply: Sure. I like the photo now that I can stand behind the words.

lines.speaker: lyla
lines.text: They asked if I wanted the laughing picture in my portfolio. The one from the park.

lines.speaker: lyla
lines.text: No. I asked for a print for myself. That's different.

choices.label: You don't owe anyone that moment
choices.reply: Exactly. Some things can just be mine.

choices.label: I'd like to see the print someday

lines.speaker: lyla
lines.text: The agency offered me another contract. Fewer hours and approval over the photos.

lines.speaker: lyla
lines.text: I think so. Not because I love the work. Because it finally leaves me room to love other things.

choices.label: Then there'll be more time for cards
choices.reply: The best clause in the contract, actually.

choices.label: I'm happy you get to choose
choices.reply: Me too. I needed that more than a bigger fee.
